_source: docs/Mutants_Game_Factions.md (v0.1, roundtable-locked). Authored catalog of record for the 9 factions (no structured engine source exists). Consumed by tools/gen_seed.mjs -> supabase/seed.sql and bundled to the client.

factions.name: The Concord
factions.ideology: Refill the thrones lawfully; gods as cosmic civil service.

factions.name: The Iron Guild
factions.ideology: Build better gods than were born; ethics are an engineering constraint.

factions.name: The Pale Court
factions.ideology: Death is just unredeemed power; the bloodline-bank aristocracy.

factions.name: The High Table
factions.ideology: The brokers — contracts, markers, the rules between god-makers.

factions.name: The Stoneblooded
factions.ideology: Old clans; endurance, tradition, the husbandry way.

factions.name: The Bloomwardens
factions.ideology: Life is sacred; tend, heal, befriend — never butcher.

factions.name: The Unbound
factions.ideology: Burn every throne; let no god rule again.
